answer.text: The manual recommends shifting down from 3rd to 2nd at 25 km/h.
Fully depress the clutch lever before the gear shift.
When slowing down, disengage the clutch completely, shift the gear, then engage the clutch gradually, not too slowly.

policy.text: Shift to the appropriate lower gear when engine speed drops, when climbing a gradient, or when running at reduced speed, to prevent the engine from stalling or straining.

watchouts.text: Releasing the clutch abruptly with too little throttle can make the engine stall.
Follow the recommended up shifting and down shifting speeds.
